notes:
The English thesaurus is much richer. It is now built on Open English WordNet as well as Wiktionary, so common words like light, house or walk get real synonyms, grouped by meaning. Corylus downloads the new data once, the next time you use the thesaurus.

The right-click menu shows the ten most useful synonyms, a few from each meaning. Define still shows every one of them.

Settings → Language & AI packs now credits Open English WordNet and Moby Thesaurus II beside Wiktionary.

The right-click menu now offers each kind of word: for "light" it shows glow and radiation, then ignite and kindle, then bright and luminous, instead of ten nouns.

The English thesaurus no longer lists types of radiation as opposites of "light", and "heavy" now sits under the weight meaning, not the brightness one. Corylus downloads the corrected data once.

Turning grammar checking on now underlines the open document straight away, and turning it off clears the underlines. Before, nothing changed until you reopened the document. Grammar also checks the page as soon as LanguageTool finishes starting.

The Spanish spelling dictionary is updated to RLA-ES 2.9, so words like «murete», «ocultamiento» and «rascarlo» are no longer underlined. Settings now gives its licence correctly.

In the Spanish interface the compile layouts of the built-in formats are called «Escena» and «Capítulo» instead of Scene and Chapter. Names you gave your own layouts stay as you wrote them.

The Spanish dictionary also knows the pronoun forms of common verbs: «ocultarle», «negarle», «deberle», «decírmelo» and thousands like them are no longer underlined.

The compile dialog is now fully in Spanish in the Spanish interface: section types, the layout preview and its sample text, the token buttons, and the suggested file name («manuscrito»).

Settings are reorganised. Each setting has one home: Typography now sits with the rest of the project's settings, read-aloud voices and ambient sounds share «Voices & audio», the assistant, its models and agent access are together under «AI», and the distraction-free background sits next to distraction-free mode.

Search in Settings finds individual settings, not just pages. Type «spacing», «dark» or «voice» and pick a result to jump straight to that control.

Settings work from the keyboard: Tab through the pages, Esc to close, and focus stays inside the window while it is open. Every theme now shows the selected page clearly.

On/off settings use the same switch everywhere, the window is larger, and the Spanish page names are shorter so they fit on one line.

macOS: Corylus is not notarized yet, so Gatekeeper may say the app cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified. Right-click (or Control-click) Corylus.app, choose Open, then Open again. Only needed once per downloaded copy.
